item.title: Pet of the Week: Eilan
item.description: Eilan is a handsome black and tan German Shepherd with a gentle soul and calm, moderate energy. Despite a rough start, he’s sweet, loyal, and eager for a fresh beginning. He enjoys short play sessions, walks nicely on leash, and responds well to kind, consistent guidance. Eilan would thrive in a relaxed home with a fenced yard, daily exercise, and people who value patience and love. He’s ready for his second chance — could it be with you? item.title: Stories in the snow: A beginner’s guide to animal tracks in Pennsylvania
item.description: BARNESVILLE — A snowy winter walk on a quiet trail in the woods may seem very boring at first. The hardwoods creak, the wind blows, and your boots crunch the snow underfoot, but if you pause and gaze down into the snow, you’ll see something else. You might not have noticed, but a lot has happened while you weren’t looking. Animal tracks, like short brushstrokes on a blank canvas, adorn the snow.
